newsitem.title: UK: UK meals/feeds end unchanged to slightly lower - Jun 20.
newsitem.headline: UK meals/feeds end unchanged to slightly lower - Jun 20.

text.p: UK meals levels ended unchanged to slightly lower in line with overnight trends but remained tradeless due to a general lack of interest in doing business.
Soybean meal values edged down by one to 1.50 sterling per tonne, with further falls likely on moday if early indications from the Chicago soybean meal futures are sustained.
Rapemeal selling levels finished completely unchanged.
